The settings one analysis was run with

Source: R/report-data.R
connectivity_settings.Rd

A key-value record of the run: what was analysed, what the caller recorded about it, what grid that produced, and what built it. One row per setting, so a run with one interpatch distance and a run with four have the same shape, and a caller recording something of its own adds a row rather than a column.

Usage

connectivity_settings(x)

Arguments

x

A connectivity_report_data object from connectivity_report_data().

Value

A tibble of setting and value, both character. A setting that doesn't apply is NA, which is written to the CSV as an empty cell.

Details

The rows an analysis can't know for itself, where the layers came from and the resolutions prepare_rasters() was called with, are whatever the caller passed as settings to connectivity_report_data().

grid_resolution_m is the grid the analysis actually ran on, unrounded. A nominally 10 m grid comes out as 10.01307 x 9.973856, and a reproduction landing on exactly 10 x 10 is a different grid, so this is the one place that doesn't go through format_resolution().

See also

connectivity_report_data(), whose settings argument fills the caller's rows, and write_connectivity_assets(), which writes this into the download bundle as summary/settings.csv.

Examples

# \donttest{
report_data <- connectivity_report_data(
  habitat = example_habitat(),
  barrier = example_barrier(),
  species = "Blue Tongue Lizard",
  interpatch_distance = c(100, 250, 400),
  settings = list(
    habitat_source = "example data: lizard",
    data_resolution_m = 10
  ),
  verbose = FALSE
)

connectivity_settings(report_data)
#> # A tibble: 15 × 2
#>    setting               value                   
#>    <chr>                 <chr>                   
#>  1 species               Blue Tongue Lizard      
#>  2 interpatch_distance_m 100, 250, 400           
#>  3 habitat_source        example data: lizard    
#>  4 data_resolution_m     10                      
#>  5 grid_resolution_m     2 x 2                   
#>  6 grid_dimensions       763 x 766               
#>  7 crs                   GDA94 / MGA zone 55     
#>  8 crs_code              EPSG:28355              
#>  9 scenario_kind         none                    
#> 10 scenario_name         NA                      
#> 11 run_time              2026-10-28T04:38:52+0000
#> 12 urbioconnect_version  0.1.0.9000              
#> 13 terra_version         1.9.50                  
#> 14 r_version             4.6.1                   
#> 15 platform              x86_64-pc-linux-gnu     
# }
